name: Necromancer 8/Assassin 1 (CR 8)
body:
DEATHWHISPER
CR 8

XP 4,800
Half-elf necromancer 8/assassin 1
NE Medium humanoid (elf, human)
Init +6; Senses low-light vision; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 13, flat-footed 19 (+3 armor, +1 deflection, +2 Dex, +1 natural, +4 shield)
hp 68 (8d6+1d8+36)
Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +6; +2 vs. enchantment
Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk dagger +4 (1d4-1/19-20)
Ranged mwk hand crossbow +7 (1d4/19-20)
Special Attacks channel negative energy (7/day, DC 16), death attack (DC 15), sneak attack +1d6
Arcane School Spell-Like Abilities (CL 8th, concentration +10)

7/day—grave touch (4 rounds)

Spells Known (CL 8th; concentration +12)

4th—animate dead, dimension door, greater false life, phantasmal killer (DC 18)
3rd—dispel magic, displacement, ray of exhaustion (DC 19), twilight knife, vampiric touch
2nd—blood armor, invisibility, knock, scorching ray, spectral hand
1st—chill touch (DC 17), decompose corpse, disguise self, expeditious retreat, feather fall, shield
0 (at will)—bleed (DC 16), detect magic, detect poison, haunted fey aspect

Opposition Schools conjuration, enchantment

TACTICS

Before Combat The assassin casts greater false life and shield.

During Combat The assassin casts invisibility on his familiar and uses it to deliver a vampiric touch, using Familiar Strike for added damage. He will use his other spells to try and eliminate targets as quickly as possible, using dimension door to escape should it appear he will lose.

Base Statistics Without greater false life and shield, the assassin’s statistics are AC 17, touch 13, flat?footed 15; hp 49.

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 18, Wis 10, Cha 14
Base Atk +4; CMB +3; CMD 14
Feats Combat Casting, Command Undead B, Familiar Strike*, Greater Spell Focus (necromancy), Improved Initiative, Scribe Scroll B, Skill Focus (Perception), Silent Spell B, Spell Focus (necromancy)
Skills Appraise +15, Disguise +6, Fly +7, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (arcana) +16, Knowledge (history) +10, Knowledge (local) +16, Knowledge (religion) +16, Linguistics +10, Perception +9, Sense Motive +4, Spellcraft +15, Stealth +6
Languages Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Infernal
SQ assassin talents (pernicious spell 1/day), arcane bond (owl), elf blood, life sight (10 ft., 8 rounds/day)
Gear potion of cure moderate wounds, scroll of fly, scroll of gaseous form, wand of enervation (5 charges), giant wasp venom (3 doses), masterwork dagger, masterwork hand crossbow and 10 bolts, masterwork studded leather, amulet of natural armor +1, cloak of resistance +1, ring of protection +1, spellbook, 300 gp worth of obsidian, 87 gp
